subject: proper-local-diffeomorphism-over-simply-connected-target
subclass_note: The canonical declined Statement omitted connectedness of the source. A disjoint union of two copies of a simply connected target maps properly and locally diffeomorphically onto the target but is not a global diffeomorphism. The coverage Statement now assumes connected source and is assigned to applications-of-the-fundamental-group, where the current proper-local-diffeomorphism theorem can be combined with later covering-space machinery.
